Global reflection supply and token supply, mutated by fee reflection and deliver.
Maximum token amount per buy, configurable by the owner.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router and pair addresses used for swaps and liquidity.

Contract token balance threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify.

Core transfer logic applying blacklist checks, cooldown, swap trigger and fee logic.

msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals and ownership checks.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the from address for transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded into transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded into transfer.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
sender parameter of transferFrom is used as transfer source.
amount parameter of transferFrom is used for allowance and transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply fee logic.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee and restoreAllFee when no fee is taken.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to the appropriate transfer variant.
Transfer variants update _rOwned and _tOwned balances.
Transfer variants call the liquidity and marketing fee takers.
Transfer variants call _reflectFee with the computed fee.
Fee collection writes the contract balance inside _rOwned and _tOwned.
_reflectFee updates _rTotal and _tFeeTotal.
Buy and sell cooldown checks rely on block.timestamp inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is stored into buycooldown and sellcooldown mappings.
Blacklist status of from and to is checked in _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the buy and sell cooldown logic.
_maxBuyAmount bounds the amount on pair buys.
Fee exclusion mappings decide whether takeFee is true.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
inSwapAndLiquify and swapAndLiquifyEnabled gate the swap trigger.
swapAndLiquify swaps accumulated tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds liquidity with part of the received ETH.
Marketing ETH is transferred to an external wallet after the swap and liquidity calls.
Local contractTokenBalance is consumed by swapAndLiquify.
Local marketingETH is the amount sent to the marketing wallet.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call with value.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used directly as the addLiquidity deadline.
clearStuckBalance transfers contract ETH to the marketing wallet.
clearStuckTokens invokes an external ERC20 transfer on an arbitrary token.
account parameter selects the blacklist target in setBlacklistStatus.
setBlacklistStatus writes _isBlacklisted using an assignment in the condition.
lock computes _lockTime from block.timestamp plus the time parameter.
time parameter is added to block.timestamp in lock.
unlock requires block.timestamp greater than _lockTime.
unlock requires msg.sender to equal _previousOwner.
unlock writes _owner back to the previous owner.
lock clears _owner before handing control to _previousOwner.
setMaxBuyPercent recomputes and writes _maxBuyAmount.
tAmount parameter is used by deliver to compute reflection amounts.
deliver calls _getValues to derive the reflection amount.
Local rAmount is subtracted from the sender balance in deliver.
deliver writes the reduced reflection balance into _rOwned.
tokenFromReflection relies on the rate derived from _getValues helpers.
The marketing wallet address is the destination of the ETH transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the token to ETH swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
External ETH transfer to the marketing wallet can re-enter the transfer path before accounting is settled.
External ERC20 transfer on an owner-supplied token can re-enter the contract logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer entry point and has no independent semantics.
The recipient parameter is a plain argument of transfer and should fold into the function node.
The sender parameter is a plain argument of transferFrom and should fold into the function node.
The account parameter is only meaningful as the target of the blacklist setter.
The time parameter is only used to derive _lockTime inside lock.
The local balance is computed and immediately consumed by swapAndLiquify.
The local marketing ETH amount exists only to size the transfer to the marketing wallet.
The tAmount parameter is only consumed by deliver for reflection math.
The local reflection amount is only used inside deliver to adjust balances.
